info.title: Project Management API
info.description: Backend API services for Project Management System

post.description: Registers a new user, hashes the password, saves to the database, and returns a JWT access token.
Authenticates user with email and password, returning a JWT access token.
Logs out the currently authenticated user.

post.summary: Unified Create API (Path variable differentiator: 'project' or 'task')
post.description: Creates a new Project or Task depending on the '{entity_type}' path variable ('project' or 'task').

schema.title: Response Manage Create Entity Api Manage  Entity Type  Post

post.summary: Unified Update API (Path variable differentiator: 'project' or 'task' + entity_id)
post.description: Updates an existing Project or Task depending on '{entity_type}' path variable and '{entity_id}'.

schema.title: Response Manage Update Entity Api Manage  Entity Type   Entity Id  Post
